package.author: JetBrains s.r.o.
package.description: An agentic development environment for multitasking with coding agents.

en-US.author: JetBrains s.r.o.
en-US.description: An agentic development environment for multitasking with coding agents.
en-US.longDescription: Air is JetBrains agentic development environment. It lets you multitask across coding agents and projects, delegate tasks to AI agents while staying in control of reviews, and work with the familiar JetBrains tooling. This is the public preview build of Air.
en-US.name: Air (Public Preview)
en-US.releaseNotes:
Air is moving into your IDE
- The standalone Air app is no longer available for download
- If you already have it installed, we will keep delivering updates for some time, but please consider this temporary.
- Thank you to everyone who tried the Air app and told us what worked and what did not. That feedback is what led us here.
- Starting with version 2026.3, Air is built into all JetBrains IDEs, including the free versions!
Give it a try jetbrains.com/air

zh-CN.description: 用于与编码智能体多任务协作的智能开发环境。
zh-CN.longDescription: Air 是 JetBrains 推出的智能开发环境（Agentic Development Environment）。它让你可以跨多个编码智能体和项目并行处理任务，在将工作委派给 AI 智能体的同时保持对代码审查的掌控，并继续使用你所熟悉的 JetBrains 工具。这是 Air 的公开预览版本。
